evidence.quote: Duration The expected duration for completing the course is 3 years.
Language Lectures, seminars, and laboratory sessions are taught in English.

If you are a non-EU candidate who requires a VISA FOR STUDY PURPOSESyou must follow the application procedures established by the Ministry of University and Research for entry, residence, and enrolment in higher education institutions for students requiring visas for higher education courses in Italy, (link to the dedicated page) by sending the pre-enrollment request through Universitaly (www.universitaly.it).

notes: Tuition is left out: the pages give no single EUR amount for a full-time Bachelor student from outside the EU living abroad; the fee rules are ISEE-band based (e.g. "Il contributo omnicomprensivo annuale massimo in assenza di attestazione ISEE ... non potrà, in nessun caso, superare € 2.257,60"), which is a band-based maximum, not a stated tuition for this applicant. Note also that the page https://orientami.poliba.it/studenti-stranieri-poliba-politecnico-di-bari/ applies to the whole institution's Bachelor (triennale) admission, and that the specific non-EU-quota places for [LT35] Ingegneria Gestionale per l'Innovazione are given on the 'Admissions - First-Level Degree Courses' page (e.g. 0 non-EU residents abroad in the Second Standard Session table, 2 in the First Standard Session table).
